svg.title: Figure 02 · Diversification removes idiosyncratic risk, not common risk
svg.desc: Each asset has 20% volatility and the displayed equal pairwise correlation. Formula σ²[ρ + (1−ρ)/n]. Nonnegative ρ keeps the correlation matrix admissible for every plotted dimension; negative equal correlation cannot be held fixed as n grows without limit.
